Countries like Nigeria and Venezuela have restrictive access to payment solutions like Stripe and PayPal. This guide addresses how to utilize Supabase as an order database, enabling you to set up a fully operational digital store that processes crypto payments seamlessly and efficiently.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often impose limitations that stifle digital commerce in many countries. COREMERCH's infrastructure meets this challenge by leveraging open-source tools and decentralized payment mechanisms. By using GitHub Pages for hosting and integrating Supabase for order management, you eliminate dependency on platforms that might reject transactions or impose high fees. This infrastructure not only supports reliable transactions but also ensures data ownership, allowing you to scale your business without the risk of sudden service interruptions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up your digital store, you need a few essential components. Start with a GitHub account for hosting your store on GitHub Pages. You'll also require a Google account to utilize Google Apps Script, which manages backend functionality. Next, sign up for a Supabase account to serve as your order database. Finally, create an account with NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions without KYC requirements. Gathering these resources creates a solid foundation for your store, enabling you to deploy Stack 01 within 4-6 hours.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your Supabase database. Create tables for orders, products, and customers to manage transactions effectively. Next, use Google Apps Script to write the backend logic that connects your store to NOWPayments, facilitating automatic payment verification. Ensure your product files are stored in a reliable location, such as Google Drive, for instant delivery upon payment confirmation. This setup ensures that your customers receive their digital products without delay, enhancing their experience and your credibility.
Own your infrastructure, don’t rent it.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After completing the setup, it's time to go live. Publish your GitHub Pages site, ensuring all links are functional and that the database connections are working correctly. Test the payment processing with a small transaction using NOWPayments. Verify that the order appears in your Supabase database and that the product is delivered as expected. This initial go-live test is crucial to confirm that all components are integrated properly, allowing you to operate with confidence.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is operational, consider expanding your offerings. Utilize Supabase's capabilities to analyze order trends and customer behavior. Incorporate additional products and refine your marketing strategies accordingly. As your sales grow, ensure your infrastructure can handle increased traffic and transactions without compromising performance. For more advanced capabilities, consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack, which includes enhanced features and is deployed by COREMERCH within 48 hours.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Building a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free involves using open-source tools and decentralized payment methods. Start with platforms like GitHub Pages for hosting, Supabase for order management, and NOWPayments for processing payments. This approach allows full control over your store without subscription fees or reliance on traditional financial services.

Test the entire flow with a small transaction.
